from solution import parse_duration
import pytest


def raises(s):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_duration(s)


def test_examples():
    assert parse_duration('PT1H30M') == 5400.0
    assert parse_duration('P1W') == 604800.0


def test_week_fraction():
    assert parse_duration('P0.5W') == 302400.0
    assert parse_duration('P1,5W') == 907200.0


def test_day_fraction_alone():
    assert parse_duration('P1.5D') == 129600.0


def test_day_with_time():
    assert parse_duration('P1DT1H') == 90000.0
    assert parse_duration('P1DT0.5S') == 86400.5


def test_time_only_variants():
    assert parse_duration('PT0S') == 0.0
    assert parse_duration('PT1.5S') == 1.5
    assert parse_duration('PT0,5M') == 30.0
    assert parse_duration('PT1M1S') == 61.0


def test_empty_and_bare():
    raises('')
    raises('P')
    raises('PT')
    raises('P1DT')


def test_week_with_time_or_day():
    raises('P1WT1H')
    raises('P1W1D')
    raises('P1D1W')


def test_fraction_not_last():
    raises('PT1.5H30M')
    raises('PT1.5M1S')
    raises('P1.5DT1H')


def test_years_months():
    raises('P1Y')
    raises('P1M')
    raises('P1Y2M3DT4H')
    raises('P1M1D')


def test_lowercase():
    raises('pt1h')
    raises('P1d')
    raises('PT1h')
    raises('p1D')


def test_order_and_duplicates():
    raises('PT1S1M')
    raises('PT1H1H')
    raises('PT30M1H')


def test_whitespace():
    raises(' P1D')
    raises('P1D ')
    raises('P1D\n')


def test_negative_and_signs():
    raises('P-1D')
    raises('PT+1H')
    raises('-P1D')


def test_bad_numbers():
    raises('PT.5S')
    raises('PT1.S')
    raises('PT1..5S')
    raises('P1.W5')
    raises('PT1e3S')


def test_no_P_or_junk():
    raises('1D')
    raises('P1DT1H junk')
    raises('PTT1H')
    raises('P1DTT1H')


def test_unicode_digits():
    raises('P\u0661D')
    raises('PT\u0663S')


def test_T_before_date_components():
    raises('PT1D')


def test_large_and_precision():
    assert parse_duration('P100D') == 8640000.0
    assert parse_duration('PT0.001S') == pytest.approx(0.001)
